note: The single action both profiles bind to. Copied from the counterpart fixture, not re-derived. Integers only (psea-02 Section 2.5).

aae_action_context_adapter.note: The AAE Section 5 constraint evaluator reads action_context.amount and action_context.currency. The shared payload names the amount amount_minor. The adapter is a rename, not a conversion: the integer value is carried across unchanged, still in minor units.
